required_content.problem: Individually valid agents and pairwise exchanges can compose into miscoordination, conflict, collusion, coalitions, cascades, concentration, common-mode failure, and gradual human disempowerment. Pairwise protocol validity, aggregate reward, apparent cooperation, equilibrium, nominal agent count, or simulated stability cannot establish collective intelligence, non-collusion, systemic safety, or retained human agency.
required_content.core_mechanism: Expanded multi-agent interaction requires a population contract binding agent/owner/model/organization identities, human participants, interaction and dependency graphs, incentives, information, resources, commitments, decision assumptions, entry/exit/copying/learning, population outcomes, externalities, human influence, interventions, costs, and residuals. Register agents, models, owners, organizations, copies, objectives, permissions, and affected humans. Map communication, trade, shared infrastructure, data, evaluators, resources, observation, and control dependencies.
required_content.worked_trace: Implement a fully observable sandbox with at least four agent identities, two model families, shared and independent infrastructure, and games separating cooperation, competition, and harmful collusion; seed known collusion, cascade, and common-mode positive controls without making social claims. Map communication, trade, shared infrastructure, data, evaluators, resources, observation, and control dependencies. Declare rewards, constraints, information, bargaining power, commitments, sanctions, and external parties. Expose causal, evidential, logical, bounded, or heuristic decision assumptions where strategic.
required_content.failure_boundary: miscoordination conflict and arms race collusion cartel or coalition formation
required_content.evidence_state: This chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its contracts, examples, tests, or local artifacts establish only their encoded scope. A finite population record refuses to infer systemic safety or beneficial cooperation from pairwise-valid interactions alone. nominal multiplicity is not effective diversity cooperation collusion coordination and collective competence remain distinct
